fix: Catch the preparation-pause persistence failure at the disconnect operation and return a safe specific ServiceError: Automatic preparation could not be paused. You are still signed in. Try signing out again. Keep account and credential removal ordering, cancellation and generation-gate cleanup unchanged.

native delete failure and explicit retry

actualMainServiceStorage.boundary: Held automatic reservation, text/voice key reads and flights, manual text/audio, neutral/saved-DJ preview and publication operations record provider counts at sign-out. Reconnect happens before releasing old callbacks; counts must not increase. Also covers stale setup/Resume, completed reconciliation and pause/delete failures.

method.native: Actual main/preload/production renderer with OS safeStorage on dummy session and local provider keys; isolated localhost Jellyfin, substituted provider responses and null shared-key adapter. Both failure branches compare canonical encrypted credential bytes before and after failure and through fresh-process restart, then explicitly retry sign-out.
method.lateCallback: Native manual text response deliberately ignores abort and is released only after reconnect. No old script/take appears, no voice dispatch follows, preparation stays paused and a new explicit request succeeds.
method.faults: Native fixture injects a local-state atomic-rename failure or connection-delete failure; real UI/main/service paths are exercised. These failures model storage faults, not their real-world frequency.
method.matrix: Actual current main/service/storage modules with isolated Electron/encryption adapters and independent disposable data per case. No real provider requests or personal credentials.
